normalizedRequirement.title: Synthetic external event processing design
normalizedRequirement.raw_text: Review a synthetic external event delivery design with normalization, one session per delivery identity, bounded retry, and an exhausted-failure handoff, without claiming unsupported runtime generation.
normalizedRequirement.business_goal: Preserve a reviewed external event-processing boundary while stopping source generation until the generic runtime supports the event source, retry, and DLQ behavior.
current_process: Receive an opaque synthetic delivery at the external runtime boundary
Validate and normalize the delivery envelope
Create one logical session for the delivery identity
Apply bounded retry and hand exhausted failures to an external dead-letter boundary

evidence.requested_goal: Review a synthetic external event processing design without generating unsupported runtime behavior.
decisions_implied: keep the external event source outside the Asset taxonomy and Graph Node set
use message.messageId as the reviewed delivery identity
create one logical session per delivery identity
stop source generation until retry and dead-letter behavior are implemented generically
assumptions: The supplied Pub/Sub-shaped event is opaque synthetic test input, not broker configuration.
The current generic generator does not implement event-source, retry/error lowering, or DLQ delivery behavior.

assetCandidates.name: Synthetic Event Processing Workflow
assetCandidates.rationale: The Workflow owns validation, normalization, processing, and reviewed failure routing; the external event source remains outside the Asset taxonomy and Graph Node set.

runtimeContracts.title: Synthetic external event delivery boundary
runtimeContracts.summary: Reviewed target contract for opaque event delivery, delivery identity, bounded retry, and exhausted-failure handoff; the current generic generator does not implement this runtime behavior.
runtimeContracts.reviewer_notes: The design boundary is approved, but Scaffold Readiness is Not Ready and source generation must stop.

policies.auth_policy: The fixture provides no production broker authentication; any future adapter requires a separately reviewed synthetic or production-neutral connection contract.
policies.timeout_policy: The reviewed target timeout is 30 seconds per delivery; the current generic generator does not emit this policy.
policies.retry_policy: The reviewed target permits at most three attempts for transient failures and deduplicates by message.messageId; the current generic generator does not emit retry or idempotency wrappers.
policies.fallback_policy: After the third failed attempt, hand the opaque delivery and failure metadata to an externally managed dead-letter boundary; the current generic generator does not emit DLQ delivery.
policies.masking_policy: Record only fixed synthetic identifiers, attempt state, and outcome evidence.
policies.data_policy: Treat pubsub-event.json as opaque synthetic test input and do not infer or contact a real cloud resource.

developer_todos: Implement a framework-neutral external event-source adapter before enabling source generation.
Implement and verify one-session-per-delivery identity plus idempotent outcome handling.
Implement and verify retry/error lowering and an external DLQ handoff before re-reviewing Scaffold Readiness.
